resources.string: Tap Stop on the floating panel to end the session

1. Pick the side you want to analyze.
2. Open a puzzle or bot practice position using 2D pieces.
3. Start Watching and grant overlay/screen sharing.
4. Set board area to match the exact 8×8 board.
5. Check Turn and White/Black below in the panel.
6. The circular arrow reads the current position again. No starting setup is needed.
Drag the square to move. Drag a corner to resize. Match the grid to the exact 8×8 board.
More time allows a deeper search. It does not set an Elo rating.

Stockfish 18 supports 1320–3190 on its calibration scale, not your Chess.com rating. Lower strength varies its position-based choices; it does not simulate a human. Uncheck to use full strength. The limit applies to the green choice; additional choices are ranked analysis alternatives.

Choose one to three candidate arrows. The optional line follows the green choice for up to three moves for each side. These are possible replies, not predictions, and the line may be shorter near game end.
Number of candidate arrows, one to three

This is the last captured crop, not a new live image. Check that it contains the complete playable board. An uncertain square means its piece or background was not recognized confidently. The image stays in memory and is not saved or uploaded.
